title: Studio metadata editor: after the server refuses an autosave 422, the status chip keeps reading "Auto-saving…" although no further save is attempted
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, stable and with a named landing point (reach: the Studio `~all` metadata editor's toolbar, 2 of 2 fresh loads).
Business reason: the chip is the author's only standing signal of whether their work is stored. After a refused save it promises a save that never comes, beside red banners that say the opposite. An author who glances at the chip, not the banners, leaves believing the edit is safe, and it is lost on the next navigation.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`SaveStatusIndicator`).
Dedupe (open and closed): `"Auto-saving"` 4 hits (two focus cards, two run records), `SaveStatusIndicator` 0, `autosave refused status chip` 22 (run records; #28984 closed, the autosave naming nothing). Nearest open: #27482 (an expression the engine refuses keeps autosaving), which is about the save not being held, not about the chip; here the save IS held and the chip is wrong.

QA-source: #29893 · studio-authoring.authoring-validation-not-persisted · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Measured at framework `589049b0` with the Console built from the same tree, as admin.

1. Create a writable runtime package and an object `NAME` with a text field `code`.
2. Open `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/object/NAME` → **Source** tab.
3. Replace the JSON with the same object where `fields.code` has no `type`.
4. One `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME?mode=draft` leaves and answers **422 INVALID_METADATA**; the located error banners render.
5. Read the toolbar status at +3 s, +11 s and +26 s.
6. **Expected:** a refused / "Not saved" state.
7. **Actual:** "Auto-saving…" (amber, the `engine.edit.autoSavingShortly` string) at all three reads. No second PUT is sent.

## Mechanism (read at 589049b0)

`SaveStatusIndicator` in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` renders the "auto-saving shortly" state whenever the page is dirty with autosave on, and has no refused state, so a page the server refused stays dirty and keeps that label.
